newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: HORSE RACING-Swan favoured to win top Cheltenham jockey award.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-Swan favoured to win top Cheltenham jockey award.

text.p: Ireland's Paddy Power bookmaker firm on Wednesday installed Irish champion national hunt jockey, Charlie Swan, as 2-1 favourite to win the top jockey award at the 1997 Cheltenham Festival.
Richard Dunwoody is quoted at 11-4 to land the title while Jamie Osborne is third favourite at 4-1.
Tony McCoy (7-1), Norman Williamson (10-1) and Paul Carberry (12-1) complete the betting.
The 1997 Cheltenham Festival will run for three days, starting on March 11.
